listing.title: Hand-Knit Cable Scarf in Powder Blue | Chunky Knit Winter Scarf | Handmade Cable Knit Wrap | Cozy Gift for Her
listing.description:
Knit by hand, stitch by stitch, this scarf has a raised cable running down the middle and a soft powder blue that sits easily with grey coats, camel and cream.

It is knit in a chunky yarn on wooden needles, so every stitch is big and easy to see. The cables are crossed by hand as the scarf grows, which is why no two come out exactly alike. The finished scarf is long enough to wrap twice and still hang, and the cable keeps its shape after a season of wear because the stitches are worked firmly rather than loosely.

The colour is a true powder blue, lighter than denim and warmer than ice blue. It photographs cooler in daylight and a touch softer indoors. If you would like the same scarf in cream, oatmeal or charcoal, send a message before ordering and it can be knit to order in the same cable.

Care is simple: hand wash cold with a little wool wash, press the water out in a towel and lay flat to dry. Do not hang it wet or the cable will stretch.

Because it is made by hand, yours may differ slightly from the photos. That is how you can tell.
listing.price_reasoning: Mid-range of 40 comparable hand-knit cable scarves ($30–$175, most at $75–$100); covers about $32 of yarn and 6 h of knitting with margin left.

listing.title: Hand-Thrown Speckled Stoneware Mug | 12 oz Handmade Ceramic Coffee Cup | Oatmeal Satin Glaze | Pottery Gift
listing.description:
Thrown on the wheel from a speckled stoneware clay, this mug holds a generous 12 ounces and sits comfortably in the hand. The satin glaze is a warm oatmeal white, and the iron in the clay burns through it in the kiln as small dark freckles, so every mug carries its own pattern.

The handle is pulled by hand and attached while the clay is still soft, then smoothed so there is no seam to catch your thumb. It is sized for three fingers and balanced so a full mug does not tip forward. The rim is thin enough to drink from easily and the base is sanded smooth so it will not scratch a table.

Each mug is fired twice, the second time to stoneware temperature, which makes it dense and durable. It is dishwasher safe and microwave safe, and the glaze is food safe. Hand washing will keep the satin surface looking its best for longer, but it is not required.

Because these are made one at a time, the speckle, the exact shade of the glaze and the height may vary a little from the photographs. Dimensions are roughly 3.6 inches tall and 3.2 inches across, not counting the handle.

Made in a small studio in Portland, Oregon, and packed in recycled paper rather than plastic.
listing.price_reasoning: Middle of 40 comparable hand-thrown speckled mugs ($34–$58); covers about $31 of clay, glaze, firing and 2.5 h at the wheel with margin left.

localizations.title: Handgedrehte Steinzeug-Tasse mit Sprenkeln | 340 ml Keramik-Kaffeebecher | Haferweiße Satinglasur
localizations.description:
Auf der Töpferscheibe aus gesprenkeltem Steinzeugton gedreht, fasst diese Tasse großzügige 340 ml und liegt angenehm in der Hand. Die Satinglasur ist ein warmes Haferweiß, und das Eisen im Ton brennt im Ofen als kleine dunkle Sprenkel hindurch, sodass jede Tasse ihr eigenes Muster trägt.

Der Henkel wird von Hand gezogen und angesetzt, solange der Ton noch weich ist, und dann geglättet.

Spülmaschinen- und mikrowellenfest. Da jede Tasse einzeln entsteht, können Sprenkel und Glasurton leicht von den Fotos abweichen.

localizations.description:
Tournée au tour dans un grès moucheté, cette tasse contient 350 ml et tient confortablement dans la main. La glaçure satinée est d’un blanc avoine chaleureux, et le fer contenu dans l’argile la traverse à la cuisson en petites taches sombres, de sorte que chaque tasse porte son propre motif.
